visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female host with short brown hair wearing a pink Nike T-shirt stands in a modern kitchen, holding a large brown cardboard box. She gestures enthusiastically towards the camera with the box and a handheld vacuum cleaner. (2) The scene shifts to a living room where she points at a pixelated area on the light wood-grain floor. (3) She demonstrates the vacuum's features, showing how to empty the dustbin into a purple trash bag with a single button press. The setting includes a gray cabinet and a refrigerator in the background. (4) She shows the various attachments, including a brush tool that slides out and an extension wand being attached. (5) The host stands in the living room, showing the vacuum standing upright on its own without support. (6) She then uses the vacuum to clean under a gray sofa; the vacuum head has built-in white LED lights that illuminate the floor. (7) She removes the transparent dust canister to show the accumulated gray dust and hair. (8) In a comedic sequence, she dances around the room as the vacuum appears to pull her along, with blue animated text appearing. (9) She concludes by talking to the camera while holding the vacuum, emphasizing its lightweight feel and ease of use in her modern apartment setting.
